rows.en: The "Gaia Gates" their plan needs are said to be in the Cube's underground area.
Start by searching that area thoroughly. I'm counting on you!
The Terror Dopant... He seems to be a truly fearsome opponent.
That much is clear from the damage Accel took...
Still, he's impressive. He's fully conscious. He has tremendous strength of will.
...Yeah. That guy's bailed us out more times than I can count.
There are two Gaia Gates left. It'll be a tough fight, but I'm counting on you.
There's only one Gaia Gate left.
But next time, the Terror Dopant is sure to come at you with everything he's got.
Don't neglect your preparations.
I've called in our Celestial Being allies, but it'll take a while to organize them into a unit.
I need you to secure an attack route for them, since they'll be coming in after you.
So you've joined up with Celestial Being's Gundams.
Your first objective is stopping the particle cannon from firing, but in battle you must adapt.
Coordinate well with one another and carry out the operation.
A Terminal Unit...? I see, an access terminal for Veda.
But only Seravee can access it. Take great care that he doesn't come under attack.
I heard your transmission with Cherudim, too. You're having trouble stopping the particle cannon?
Use the Ride Machine to destroy the turret itself from outside the Cube.
Thanks to you, we at least escaped a direct hit from the particle cannon.
But there's no denying we've taken heavy damage.
We probably won't survive the next one...
...What are you doing? Your target is the Terminal Unit in Area 2, isn't it?
You should be able to enter the Cube through the gate the Psycho Gundam Mk-II's explosion made...
Have you been there yet?
If not, focus your search there. I'm counting on you.
That direct hit earlier was a serious blow. And to think it was only a test shot...
...I'm having every facility checked as we speak.
...The comms filled me in. Who knew there were giant weapons besides the particle cannon?
Memento Mori, the Barge Cannon, the Libra Cannon... and the Colony Laser...
But we mustn't give up. Carry out the operation Seravee devised
and stop the enemy's plan!
So Master Gundam has appeared... Their use of DG Cells seems to be advancing, too.
And the Zero System as well... If we don't crush it early, it'll become a threat.
...The giant weapons run on Minus Energy given off by the enemy itself?
If that's true, cutting off their power source would be an extremely inefficient approach.
In practice, I'd say it's impossible...
Also, we've lost contact with the Gundam Team. Follow their attack route and join them, quickly.
The Gundam Team stopped Memento Mori and the Barge Cannon before they could fire.
Still left: the Libra Cannon and Colony Laser. We know where the Libra Cannon is, so stop it first.
What!? Strike the Libra Cannon's reactor core directly? That's a dangerous plan...
But it's also a sure one. We're short on time, so hurry!
Only the Colony Laser is left! We're almost there. Stay sharp and see the operation through!!
You've found out where the Colony Laser is?
A huge space...? That sounds suspicious...
Whatever the case, hurry!
What!? Reborns had Seravee in his sights!!
And we were just one step away...!! Go to his aid at once!!
...Yes, we heard Seravee's voice as well. His will lives on inside Veda.
Do as he says. Then you're sure to finish off Reborns!
This will most likely be the decisive battle. Steel yourselves.
Don't worry. Leave the defense of the base to us.
So Belial has revived the monsters...
I expected as much once the Plasma Spark was stolen, but...
The monsters should be stronger than before. If you fight them, be very careful.
So they were using the "Memory Memory" to gather combat data...
Yeah... There's no way of knowing just how much info ended up in enemy hands.
Seravee is predicting the location. All we can do is head there.
The Devil Gundam. So it was still alive...!!
No need to be surprised. It's just what I expected.
It seems Belial and the Dinosaur Greeed were keeping it in reserve as part of their forces.
They've left us a troublesome enemy.
Then we find it and smash it, that's all.
What is the Dinosaur Greeed scheming with the "Memory Memory"...!?
He said we have Minus Energy in us, too... It's hard to believe, but...
And Veda is in a state of emergency, too.
Yes, we've heard Seravee's voice. He says the enemy's territory is expanding...
That's bad...
And we can't forget the Devil Gundam. It's fused with the Cube.
The Devil Gundam... How on earth are we supposed to beat it?
Like Ankh said, we should look for the spot that serves as its core.
Right. Either way, all we can do is search every inch of the place.
If you sense strong Minus Energy there, that may be the Devil Gundam's core.
...Yeah. It's possible.
In any case, we need to confirm what's at that spot.
Got it. Leave it to me.
So you've stopped the Devil Gundam in its tracks!
We only shut off its power. We haven't destroyed it completely.
Even so, the paths tangled with tentacles should be open now. Let's call that a win for now.
Yes! This could be our breakthrough!!

notes.note: SPEAKERS from tools/talkspk.py Command (Talk01_50-74): Zoffy for all rows except #0.471/#0.664 W (Shotaro); #0.665/#0.689 00; #0.674/#0.677/#0.692/#0.694/#0.700/#0.702/#0.711 God Gundam; #0.676 Seven; #0.687/#0.691/#0.693/#0.695 Rider 1; #0.713 Black RX. #0.538 and #0.623 have no mapped speaker; treated as Zoffy continuing (same script block).
Quoted Gaia Gate made plural: later rows say two, then one, remain. Subject of 'their plan' = the enemy's Gaia Impact plan (#0.457, talk_002).
W (Shotaro) about Accel; object of 'helped' dropped in source. Rendered 'us' (Shotaro and Philip / the team); could be 'me'.
Shinkou ruto = 'attack route' (invasion route), reused at #0.583.
Houtou hontai = the cannon's turret itself; lowercase 'turret' (glossary UI 'Gun Turret' is a target label, not used in dialogue here).
Sentence runs into #0.560; split at the same point.
Zero System = enemy research (as in story); 'it' = the Zero System threat.
Rokushin = reactor core, matching story 'the Libra's reactor core'.
Hosoku = had caught/locked onto; Reborns (Ribbons, g=m) -> 'his sights'.
00. 'The location' kept unspecified as in source (likely the Dinosaur Greeed / next target).
Literal 'confirm that location' expanded to 'confirm what's at that spot' for natural English.
Black RX per script; 'Yes!' renders aa plus the exclamatory tone. God Gundam's reply #0.714 is in talk_004.

report: 80/80. Speakers from talkspk.py (mostly Zoffy; W (Shotaro), 00, God Gundam, Seven, Rider 1, Black RX where mapped). #0.538/#0.623 unmapped, assumed Zoffy. Uncertain: #0.471 'us' vs 'me'; #0.665 unspecified location. No new names.
